EDIT.TITLE: Edit this asset
EDIT.NAME: Name
EDIT.ROLE_HELP: It's the “RoleArn” value of the stack in AWS. Change it only if you created another role.
EDIT.KEYS_HELP: For security we don't show the saved keys. Leave them empty to keep them, or paste the two new ones to replace them.
EDIT.CHANGES_CONNECTION: You changed what is assessed, so after saving you will have to check the connection again. What we already measured is kept.
EDIT.EVALUATE_SAVE_FIRST: Save your changes first so we evaluate with the new details.
EDIT.SAVE_ERROR: We couldn't save the changes. Please try again.

PANEL.TITLE: Give read-only access to your AWS account
PANEL.INTRO: You create a role that can only read your account's configuration. You don't share passwords or keys, and you can delete the role whenever you want.
PANEL.PASTE_VALUES: When AWS asks for the parameters, paste these two values:
PANEL.MISSING_PRINCIPAL: Monkey doesn't have the identity that assumes the role configured yet. Let us know before continuing.
PANEL.ROLE_HELP: It's the “RoleArn” value in the Outputs tab of the stack in AWS.

FORM.TITLE: Your account details
FORM.READ_ONLY_NOTE: Monkey only reads, it never changes anything. What you share (keys or passwords, if your connection asks for them) is stored encrypted and is not shown again.
FORM.NAME_HINT: Give it a name so you can recognize it later.
FORM.METHOD_LABEL: How do you want to connect your {{name}} account?
FORM.METHOD_ROLE_HELP: You don't share any password or key: you create a role in your account that can only read, and you tell us which one it is.
FORM.METHOD_KEYS_HELP: You paste a read-only access key. It lasts a long time, so it is less secure than a role.
FORM.ACCOUNT_HELP: It's 12 digits. You see it at the top right of the AWS console, when you open your user menu.
FORM.ACCOUNT_HINT: Enter the 12 digits of the account.
FORM.REGIONS_LABEL: In which regions do you have resources?
FORM.REGIONS_HELP: We will only look at the regions you choose. You can select several.
FORM.KEYS_NOTE: Use an IAM user that only has the SecurityAudit and ViewOnlyAccess policies. The key is stored encrypted and is not shown again.
FORM.IMPORTANCE: How important is it for your service?
FORM.ALSO_SUPPORTS: Does it also support other services?
FORM.ALSO_SUPPORTS_HELP: This way you don't register it twice. It's optional.
FORM.CHECK_MARKED: Check the marked fields and try again.
FORM.METHOD_NOT_APPLICABLE: That connection type isn't available for this platform. Choose another one.
FORM.REGISTER_ERROR: We couldn't register the asset. Please try again.
